title: Bartholomew's Sweet Surprise
markdown:
The moon smiled down like a friendly nightlight. In a cozy nest, Hazel the owl blinked. “Oh, Benji,” she hooted. “Today is Bartholomew Bumble’s sweet shop day.”

Benji the rabbit’s nose twitched. “Hooray,” he squeaked. “Bartholomew’s shop smells like sunshine and giggles.”

They hopped and fluttered through the woods. The path glowed soft and warm. Soon Bartholomew Bumble’s sweet shop twinkled with a happy light.

Inside, Bartholomew the deer, wearing his glasses, hummed and filled colourful jars. Red cherry drops, yellow lemon sweets, blue raspberry jellies — they sparkled. “Perfect,” he whispered.

Ting-a-ling. Mrs Higgins the hedgehog shuffled in. “Those yellow ones are sunny,” she rumbled, “but I want a fizzy one that tickles.”

Bartholomew blinked. “Oh,” he said. “They aren’t all yellow.” He looked a little puzzled.

Finley Fox arrived next. “I want something crunchy,” he said. Bartholomew showed him nutty sweets that looked like tiny brown stones. Finley grinned, already imagining the crunch, crunch, crunch.

Soon friends filled the shop. Bartholomew watched, his brow a little furrowed. Little Tilly Mouse chose a long wiggly sweet. “It’s a climbing rope,” she giggled. Gwynedd Bear picked a soft chewy sweet. “Its wrapper sounds like a happy sigh,” he rumbled.

Hazel and Benji hopped up. Bartholomew sighed. “My colours aren’t the most popular,” he said, feeling a little sad.

“Oh, Bartholomew,” chirped Captain Wren, landing on a shelf. “Your colours are lovely, but sweets are special for happy things.” He pointed to sparkly stars. “These look like the twinkly night sky.”

Hazel smiled. “I’ll have one,” she hooted. “They remind me of the stars.”

Benji wiggled his nose. “And I want one that goes crunch,” he declared. He found a bumpy sweet, perfect for crunching.

Bartholomew watched his friends happily munching. He saw their smiling faces. He gave everyone their sweets. Hazel and Benji thanked him with happy hoots and squeaks. They left with their special treats. The shop filled with the wonderful sound of happy customers, jars still twinkling, wrappers still sighing, and Bartholomew humming again, glasses slipping, as the moon kept smiling down.
characters: Hazel (a nest owl), Benji (a twitching-nose rabbit), Captain Wren (a shelf-landing wren)
author: StoryGen Community
